Compare verification timing, per-agent resources and replanning without presuming C outperforms B.

metric_definitions.verified_ground_fraction: Verified executed ground metres / all executed ground metres, using knowledge at traversal time. Null for zero distance or unavailable execution evidence.
metric_definitions.unsafe_step_count: Count from all instrumented executed ground steps. Zero requires every step checked; null when no traversal/checking evidence exists.
metric_definitions.optional_tasks_accepted: Number of distinct optional task IDs assigned; repeated events and replans do not count twice.
metric_definitions.optional_tasks_rejected: Number of distinct optional task IDs rejected, retaining reason codes.
metric_definitions.time_to_verified_route_s: Simulated seconds from run start to first route meeting the frozen verification rule; null if none. FEASIBLE does not prove actual traversal.
metric_definitions.mission_duration_s: Simulated seconds from run start to terminal state; null if no terminal simulated timestamp exists.
metric_definitions.energy_est_wh: Per-agent modeled gross expenditure including movement, work and waiting. Human metabolic Wh and robot electrical Wh remain separate.
metric_definitions.oxygen_est_l: Human-only modeled oxygen in equivalent dry ideal litres at 273.15 K and 101325 Pa, including all outside-base activities.
metric_definitions.replan_count: Number of distinct replanning request IDs after the initial plan, excluding idempotent duplicates.
metric_definitions.replan_latency_ms: Median steady-wall-clock dispatch-to-response latency for resolved replans; retain individual request IDs and timeouts; null with no responses.
metric_definitions.max_map_age_s: Maximum simulation-time decision timestamp minus its public map batch timestamp across authorized routes; null with no authorized decision.

notes: Template only: no scenario, run, scientific approval or result is supplied.

reference_id is an opaque evaluator identifier, never a path loaded by mission/planner/auditor.
